features.quote: Stop Conditions | 1. Agent emits string [[ABANDON]] or [[GIVE_UP]] 2. Agent claims task is finished 3. Step limit reached 4. 3+ consecutive identical bash commands (dedup kill-switch)
features.justification_quote: Prevents accidental infinite loops that pollute severity scoring.
